description: SKILL.md (present in BOTH the worktree copy and the canonical `~/anicca/skills/earn/pm-trade/SKILL.md`) states, verbatim: 'Money-safe today: no signing / order-placement code exists in this slot -- the real executor is intentionally not wired (fail-closed)' and 'No private key is read and no order endpoint is POSTed anywhere in this slot.' Both statements are directly false for the reviewed tree: order.py (in the SAME directory) reads the founder's private key (order.py:22-29) and calls `client.create_and_post_order` (order.py:72) whenever the three gate env vars align. Any operator or automated agent reading SKILL.md before flipping DRY_RUN=false would be told, incorrectly, that no such code exists -- a direct spec-vs-implementation contradiction in the file that is supposed to be the safety-relevant source of truth for this slot.
